blocks.p: Angel finds a flyer for the old station and writes his plan in the journal. This chapter explains the *Journal* tab of the *Character* window, in Figure 3-1, and the reader, in Figure 3-2.

The *Journal* tab keeps a log of your days. The *Page* pop-up at the top left chooses what the tab shows: the journal, notebooks, papers or recipes. To add an entry, type it in the box under the search field and click *Save*. *Into* shows where the entry goes: here, the log only. Entries are grouped by month, and each carries the day and the time it was written.
To find an entry, type in the search field beside the *Page* pop-up. The help line at the foot of the window gives the window's status while the pointer is over nothing.

blocks.p: A flyer opens in the reader, shown in Figure 3-2. The page fills the window. The column at the right sets out *This piece*, its kind and whether you have read it, and *Places*, the places that the piece names.
*Show on map* marks a place on the map. The map is described in Chapter 4.
At the foot of the window, *Paper* shows the page as it is printed and *Words* shows its text. The buttons at the right end of the foot set the zoom.
